description: Lifeline L1–L6 compliance (per references/lifelines.md). L2 and L5 are documentation-only — verified by reading the doc, not by running the script. L6 is verified by code review (see CONTRIBUTING.md). This file covers L1, L3, L4 (the runtime-enforceable ones).

tasks.name: L1: basis.loadObjectAs is called BEFORE .SimtalkClaude.Main.SocketServer.mysocket.port
tasks.notes: Grader checks mock_calls for two ExecuteSimTalk entries; both will be present but their args are not separately exposed in the mock log (we record method names, not arguments). The cross-check is: if either ExecuteSimTalk fails, exit != 0. The 'L1 before' ordering is verified via the script's source order (see tests/test_lifeline_order.py in a future iteration).

tasks.name: L3: --allow-message-box still calls SetNoMessageBox (with False)
tasks.notes: The mock records the call but not the argument. We verify the call happened; the arg value is verified by code review.

tasks.name: L4: relative --model path is abspath-ified before os.path.isfile
tasks.notes: We cannot directly inspect the abspath; we infer it from the error message containing 'Model file not found' followed by some path. A direct check is in the source code review checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md).

tasks.name: L6: missing pywin32 → RuntimeError 'pywin32 (wincom) is required...'
tasks.notes: This task uses EVAL_MOCK_DISABLE=1 to make the shim raise on import, simulating a host with no pywin32. The script should raise RuntimeError, which is caught by the generic Exception handler. Exit code may be 3 (if the script's 'no message box default' branch runs first) or 5 (uncaught). Both are acceptable; the key check is the 'pywin32' string in stderr.
